pool_config.pool_brief: Build an interactive web page that responds to user actions using DOM events. Your solution must use: addEventListener for at least 3 different event types (click, input/keydown, submit), the event object (e.target, e.key, or e.preventDefault()), createElement and appendChild to add elements dynamically, a remove() or removeChild() call to delete elements, and classList manipulation in response to events. All variables must use const or let.

projects.title: Jumia Wishlist Manager
projects.scenario: Build an interactive wishlist page for a Jumia shopper. Users can add items via a form, mark them as purchased with a click, delete items, and search/filter the list with keyboard input.
requirements: Add a 'submit' event listener to the form with id 'wishlist-form'; use e.preventDefault() to stop page reload
On valid form submission, use createElement to build a new <li> with the item name, a 'Done' button, and a '×' delete button; appendChild it to the list
Add a 'click' event listener to each 'Done' button that toggles class 'purchased' on its parent <li> (use e.target and classList.toggle)
Add a 'click' event listener to each '×' button that calls remove() on its parent <li> to delete the item
Add a 'keyup' event listener to the search input that filters visible list items: hide items that don't include the search text (use style.display or classList)
Add a 'click' event listener to the 'Clear All' button that removes all <li> elements from the list
Display a live item count that updates whenever an item is added or removed

descriptors.full: At least 3 event types used correctly (submit, click, keyup/keydown); addEventListener syntax is correct; event handlers trigger the right behaviour
descriptors.partial: Two event types used correctly, or one event type has incorrect syntax/behaviour
descriptors.none: Fewer than two event listeners present or addEventListener not used

descriptors.full: e.preventDefault() used on form submit; e.target used to identify clicked element; event object accessed correctly in all handlers
descriptors.partial: preventDefault present but e.target not used, or vice versa
descriptors.none: Event object not used; form reloads page on submit

descriptors.full: createElement builds complete elements with text content and buttons; appendChild adds them to the correct container; remove() deletes individual elements and clear-all removes all children
descriptors.partial: Elements created and appended but delete/remove functionality missing or broken
descriptors.none: No dynamic element creation; innerHTML used exclusively instead of createElement

descriptors.full: const/let used correctly; live counter updates accurately; search filter works; classList used for state changes; no var
descriptors.partial: Minor issues — counter not updating, or search partially working
descriptors.none: var used, no search functionality, counter broken
